subject: general
question: In which state of India is the Gulbarga Fort situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __Karnataka.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Gulbarga Fort is situated in Kalaburagi, a city in the Indian state of Karnataka.
 
• The Gulbarga Fort was constructed by Alauddin Hasan Bahman Shah, the king of the Bahmani dynasty. 
 
• The fort has an area of approx 0.5 acres (0.20 ha) and periphery length of 3 kilometres (1.9 mi). 
 
• It is well protected with double fortification.
 
• A 30 feet (9.1 m) wide moat bordering the fort.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Kangra Fort is the largest fort in the Himachal pradesh and perhaps the oldest fort in India (and hence in the world) and one of the most picturesque forts.​ 
 
• Talatal Ghar, Agnigarh and Garchuk Lachit Garh are the three famous forts in Assam.
 
• Agra Fort is a historical fort in the city of uttar pradesh (Agra) in India.
